entities.name: Query protein 743 aa
observations: Sequence length is 743 aa; estimated molecular weight 79.18 kDa and pI 5.49.
Sequence analysis detected an N-terminal PfkB domain (PF00294.30; residues 41-357; i-Evalue 1.7e-49).
Sequence analysis detected a C-terminal AP-endonuclease-family domain (PF01261.31; residues 478-707; i-Evalue 4.2e-17).
No explicit catalytic reaction, EC number, or cofactor annotation was retrieved; exact substrate specificity remains unresolved.

The architecture is consistent with a putative PfkB-like carbohydrate kinase domain fused to an AP-endonuclease-related domain, but the bifunctional interpretation is not experimentally or curatorially confirmed.

entities.name: Unresolved catalytic assignment
observations: PfkB-family membership supports a ribokinase-like carbohydrate kinase/phosphorylase fold, commonly associated with ATP and divalent metal use, but PF00294 alone does not determine substrate or exact reaction.
The C-terminal AP-endonuclease-family assignment is compatible with an AP-endonuclease-related activity, but a domain hit alone does not establish DNA-repair function in this fusion protein.
